hook_segment.text: מצאתי את הפתרון לבעיה שכולנו מכירות

causes_to_rate.a: Weak opening visual — flat catalog shot, no motion cue
causes_to_rate.c: AliExpress catalog feel — reads as a marketplace thumbnail, not organic TikTok
causes_to_rate.d: Generic hook text — no specific number/problem/surprise
causes_to_rate.e: Hook–product mismatch — text promises something the image doesn't show
causes_to_rate.h: Non-native Hebrew phrasing — grammatically valid but reads as translated/stilted

a.evidence: Same shared asset again: 0s/1s/1.5s show the identical static AliExpress hero-render (product + English badges), hard cut at 2s to the identical static AliExpress listing screenshot, held through 2.5s/3s. No motion inside either half in the full 0-3s window.

b.evidence: Product (magnetic car phone mount) is clearly visible and labeled at 0s, identical to the other three variants.

c.evidence: Identical to 002A/002B: CGI-style AliExpress hero render with English badges (0-1.5s) cutting to a literal AliExpress listing-page screenshot (2-3s, Express/Choice badge, strikethrough price, delivery-date text). Reads as marketplace material regardless of the Problem/Solution hook text layered on top.

d.evidence: Hook text 'מצאתי את הפתרון לבעיה שכולנו מכירות' ('I found the solution to a problem we all know') never states what the problem actually is -- no specific pain point (e.g. phone sliding off the dashboard, losing signal, etc.), no number, no concrete surprise. 'A problem we all know' is a placeholder phrase that could preface literally any product; it carries a Problem/Solution structure but zero specific content.

e.evidence: Hook promises a problem-and-solution narrative, but the frames never show or dramatize any problem at all -- 0-1.5s is a static, motionless product render, and 2-3s is just an AliExpress price screenshot. There is no before/after, no demonstration of a struggle being solved, nothing that visually corresponds to 'a problem we all know' -- the visual and the promised narrative arc don't connect.

h.evidence: 'מצאתי את הפתרון לבעיה שכולנו מכירות' reads as natural, colloquial spoken Hebrew, not translated or stilted. Worth flagging separately (outside this cause's definition): 'מכירות' is the feminine-plural form ('we all [f] know'), an explicit female-only address consistent with the feminine forms used across all four 002 hook texts/captions -- a gender-neutrality issue per the project's own copy rules, but not a translation-quality issue.

step11d_divergence_note: NO STEP 11D SCORE EXISTS FOR THIS PRODUCT -- same confirmed absence across all four 002 variants (output/2026-06-14-product-002-upload_package.md has only a product-level 'STEP 3C: PASS', no per-variant STEP 11D verdict/score). Nothing to diverge from for 002C specifically. Real-world result: WEAK retention (28% at 2s, n=390 views, the largest sample of the four).
